note: Fixed request settings per arm for the video-gen eval. 'draft' until one timing probe per model sets them; then 'status' becomes 'locked' and nothing here changes. A probe may move a model to its 'fallback' size: copy the fallback into 'form' before you lock. scripts/videogen/generate.py refuses a scored run from a draft file.

h3.note: The H3 runbook section 3 command, in the 0.32.0 venv, plus --served-model-name so the request can name the model.

h3-t2v.weights: FL2VA partition; the NAS copy (rev 42ed227) is file-identical to HF main 0919fb68
h3-t2v.sources: flow_shift 12 and audio_flow_shift 3.0: the H3 runbook (upstream GB10 recipe). 50 steps: H3's full-quality setting. No negative_prompt: the runbook sends none.

h3-i2v.weights: FL2VA partition; the NAS copy (rev 42ed227) is file-identical to HF main 0919fb68
h3-i2v.input_note: No aspect_ratio: for fl2va the server takes the ratio from the image. Because width and height are sent, the server resizes the 1920x1080 first frame to 1280x704 before H3 sees it, which stretches it about 2% wide (16:9 is 1.778; 1280x704 is 1.818).
